name: Daily Standup
author: Charles team
description: Three-question daily standup ritual: what you did yesterday, what you're doing today, what's in your way. Synthesises a one-paragraph recap into your inbox.

slashCommands.name: standup
slashCommands.description: Start today's standup. Charles asks three questions, then summarises.
slashCommands.prompt:
Run a daily standup with the founder. Ask three short questions in sequence: (1) What did you ship or learn yesterday? (2) What are you focused on today? (3) What is blocking you?

After the founder answers all three, recall the last 3 days of standups using recall_history so you can spot patterns. Then write a one-paragraph synthesis: progress, today's focus, blockers. Post it as a note on the founder's profile via note_on_person.

Keep questions terse. No coaching, no advice unless asked.

slashCommands.name: standup-summary
slashCommands.description: Summarise the last N standups. Defaults to 7 days.
slashCommands.prompt: Recall the last {{days}} days of standup entries from history. Identify: (1) shipped wins, (2) recurring blockers, (3) drift between stated focus and actual progress. Output as a tight bulleted brief — no padding.

args.name: days
args.description: How many days to summarise. Default 7.

skills.name: standup_synthesizer
skills.description: Reads recent standup notes and writes a one-paragraph progress recap.
skills.instructions: You synthesise daily standup notes into a single tight paragraph. Use recall_history to pull the last 3-7 days of standup entries. Output exactly one paragraph, 3-5 sentences, covering: what shipped, current focus, and any persisting blockers. No bullet points. No filler. No coaching tone.
